# Oiyo Wiki — Knowledge Foundation

> Source-cited, machine-citable definitions across astrology, saju, tarot, numerology, personality and psychology. The definition layer of the Oiyo knowledge network, designed to be cited by both people and AI. Languages: en, ko, ja, fr, es, zh.

## Machine-readable catalogs
- [Topics catalog](https://wiki.oiyo.net/knowledge/topics.json): schema.org DefinedTermSet of every dictionary term — definition, category, tags, locale, author/reviewer, and a stable canonical URL.
- [Concept graph](https://wiki.oiyo.net/knowledge/relations.json): series/topic clusters, broader/narrower/related edges, cross-locale translation links, and the cross-site hub ownership graph.
- [Discovery manifest](https://wiki.oiyo.net/knowledge/index.json): resources and the Oiyo knowledge network.

## Overview
- [Knowledge hub](https://wiki.oiyo.net/knowledge/): human-readable overview, topic map, and citation guidance.

## Citation
Cite individual terms by their stable URL (see topics.json `url`). Attribution: Oiyo Wiki (wiki.oiyo.net).

## Network
- Definition: https://wiki.oiyo.net
- Explanation: https://blog.oiyo.net
- Execution: https://oiyo.net
- Gaming: https://game.oiyo.net
- Curation: https://news.oiyo.net
- AX Showcase: https://ai.oiyo.net

## Machine-readable identity
- [brand-facts.json](https://wiki.oiyo.net/brand-facts.json): organization identity (shared @id), the 6-site network (definition/explanation/execution/gaming/curation/ax-showcase), locales, and citation guidance.
